## Game Code & Technical Design Knowledge Card  
**Date:** 2026-08-11  
**Source:** [Raw Research 2026-08-11]([insert source URL if available])  

---

### ECS Architectures  
- **Unity DOTS**: Jobs System + burst compiler for parallelism; cache-friendly data layout (Unity 2024.2+ wrinkle compression)  
  - [Unity DOTS Docs](https://unity.com)  
- **Bevy Engine**: Pure ECS with schedules; prioritize system grouping for cache efficiency  
- **Flecs/Ebt/exc**: Lightweight entities (Entt 2024) or GPU-native DAGScheduler (Unreal 5.3)  
- **Invarants**: Avoid inheritance, enforce component data purity for determinism  

---

### State Machines  
- **Zenject (Unity)**: Conditional state chains; supports nested transitions (e.g., combat + animations)  
- **Godot 4.x**: Behavior tree integration for data-driven logic; GGScript/C# support  
- **Unreal GAS**: Gameplay tags for condition-based states; RPG-style ability hierarchies  

---

### 3D Movement  
- **KCC (Unity)**: Continuous collision detection via `radius` + `Interpolate` Rigidbody settings  
  - [Unity Rigidbody Guide](https://docs.unity3d.com)  
- **Root Motion Blending (Unreal 5.3)**: Smooths animation-physics transitions using blend weights  
- **Friction Gradient (Unity 2024.3)**: Adjusts slide friction on inclines via dynamic coefficient values  

---

### Collision Detection  
- **Hybrid Layers (Unreal 5.2)**: GPU-filtered queries reduce CPU overhead (documentation)  
- **CCD (Godot 4.1+)**: `actor.rigid_body.cd_grain_all` for precise moving object contact  
- **Edge Cases**: Slope angle thresholds (e.g., Unity `maxStepAngle` for terrain adaptability)  

---

### Pathfinding  
- **D* Lite (2024)**: Dynamic grids with real-time replanning (dpluststar.com)  
- **NavMesh (2024)**: Godot 4.2 optimizations for 2D tile worlds; Unreal EQS for runtime checks  
- **Optimization**: Jump Point Search for grid-based games (Flat-Out Gaming)  

---

### Engine-Specific Patterns  
- **Unity**: Addressables + ECS for asset management + performance  
  - [Addressables Docs](https://unity.com)  
- **Unreal**: Data Assets for smart defaults; GAS blueprint integration  
- **Godot**: Node-based signals for decoupled system communication  
  - [Godot Signals](https://godotengine.org)  

---

### Networking  
- **Connection Authority**: Server-only physics; Unity Netcode C# `ClientRpc` synchronizers  
- **Delta Compression (Unity 2025.1)**: Reduces payloads for streaming updates  

---

### Performance  
- **SoA Layouts**: Cache alignment for ECS component arrays  
- **Culling**: Unity’s occlusion culling + GPU leaves in Unreal (LOD systems forall)  
- **Shader Optimization**: Unity 2025 dynamic property clamping for dynamic draw reduction  

---

**Practical Use Case Tip**: For real-time replanning pathfinding, combine D* Lite with Unity DOTS Jobs for frame-rate stability.
